edits.old: The operation name, the request and response fields, the 2 s budget, the failure answer and the fields of the answer are not specified in any source document and are the working read of ASM-3071 (GAP-1875); the operation is faked in every test and never called live.
edits.new: The operation name, the request and response fields, the 2 s budget, the failure answer and the fields of the answer are the working read of ASM-3071 (GAP-1875), published in RWB-S2-E3005-CON: the operation `calculateRestructurePlan` in the `ace-collection` namespace takes the case ID, the plan inputs and the rule version, and answers `affordabilityResult`, `planRef`, `installmentAmount`, `installmentCount` and `calculatedAt`, with a 2 s synchronous budget and the workflow's retry; when the calculator does not answer, the stage is held in `AFFORDABILITY_IN_ACE` with MSG-GEN-006. The operation is faked in every test and never called live.

edits.old: A refusal or a timeout is shown as the message on the treatment screen and raises an incident, never as a silent empty state.
edits.new: A refusal or a timeout is shown as the message on the treatment screen and raises an incident, never as a silent empty state. The states of SCR-14 and SCR-15 are empty, loading, error and no access, as set out in the Target reading of section 7; Screen Specifications v1 does not give them, so their source is Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-8540; CG-ALL-8541).

  Scenario: AC10 Rules BR1 to BR8 hold (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the RESTRUCTURE rule package in force carries R-RES-06 and R-RES-07
    When the affordability step runs
    Then each rule in section 8 holds, and a rule that is an architecture constraint is checked by a guardrail or boundary test instead

  Scenario: AC11 Calculator does not answer in time (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the ACE Common calculator does not answer inside the 2 s budget
    When the affordability step runs
    Then the workflow retries per its policy and, when the attempts are exhausted, the stage stays in AFFORDABILITY_IN_ACE with MSG-GEN-006
    Then nothing is written and the case does not move

  Scenario: AC12 Disallowed status change is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the parent applies a status change that the case model does not allow
    When the stage reports its outcome
    Then the change is refused and nothing changes, and this service moves no status itself
    Then the refusal message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3005-APP-AC12)
